title: Vendor activation: finalizing invoice intake path and compact invoice sample
text:
Vendor activation: finalizing invoice intake path and compact invoice sample

['From: Sara Bennett <sara@acmesupply.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice intake question for activation

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the kickoff yesterday — quick question as we prepare the activation packet: does Redwood prefer vendors to submit invoices via the portal (preferred) or is emailing invoices to invoices@redwood.com acceptable as a fallback?

If we move forward with email fallback, could you share a minimal invoice sample (CSV or PDF) and confirm how you want PO numbers surfaced (subject line / filename / embedded field)? Also any file naming conventions (entity suffixes, currency code) would help.

I attached our internal sample invoice for reference (pdf) and can reformat if needed.

Thanks,
Sara Bennett
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Acme Supply
S: +1 415-555-0199

Attachment: acme_sample_invoice_07_22.pdf (invoice PDF stub)', 'From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Sara Bennett <sara@acmesupply.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice intake question for activation

Hi Sara — great to hear from you. Short answers first: portal is preferred for onboarding (faster ACKs, automated PO matching), email to invoices@redwood.com is an acceptable fallback during the activation window.

Kimberly (AP) is copied — she manages the invoice template and PO stamping rules. Kimberly, can you drop the compact template and the onboarding form for Acme?

For immediate guidance to Acme:
- Preferred: submit via vendor portal link we’ll provide; portal will ask for PO(s) at upload time.
- Fallback: send PDF/CSV to invoices@redwood.com with the following filename pattern: REDWOOD_PO_<PO#>_<entity>_<YYYYMMDD>_<currency>.pdf (example: REDWOOD_PO_124578_RED_US_20250720_USD.pdf).
- PO number: best if included in the filename and in an invoice field. If multiple POs on one invoice, include all POs in the filename separated by hyphens.

I attached the high-level activation checklist for reference — please complete the onboarding form so AP can provision portal access and validate sample lines.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Program Manager, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: activation_checklist_v1.pdf (stub)', 'From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sara Bennett <sara@acmesupply.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice intake question for activation

Hi Sara — welcome! I‘ll own the AP side for Acme. Attaching the current vendor onboarding form and our compact invoice CSV template (single-line per shipped PO). Quick checklist and acceptance criteria below.

Required fields (portal or email):
- Redwood PO number (exact match required)
- Invoice number (unique)
- Invoice date (YYYY-MM-DD)
- Line item description and net amount (currency indicated)
- Billing entity (Redwood entity name)

Filename convention (if emailing):
- Use: REDWOOD_PO_<PO#>_<ENTITYCODE>_<YYYYMMDD>_<CUR>.ext
- If multiple POs: REDWOOD_PO_<PO1>-<PO2>_ENTITY_20250722_USD.pdf

Portal notes (preferred):
- Portal provides immediate ACK and automated PO-match. Please use the portal for any invoices > $5k or multi-PO invoices.
- Small single-PO invoices (< $5k) can be emailed during activation if portal access is pending.

Onboarding form and sample template attached. Once you return the onboarding form, we will:
1) Provision portal access (24–48 hours)
2) Test 1 sample invoice via portal and confirm ACK
3) Move to production acceptance

Edge cases: multi-entity invoices need the billing entity field filled out — we won’t accept cross-entity aggregation without prior approval.

HubSpot ticket: #ACME-549 (link in thread metadata).

Attachments:
- redwood_onboarding_form_v2.xlsx
- compact_invoice_template.csv

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior AP Ops Specialist
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 650-555-0104

[On Tue, Jul 22, 2025 at 09:05 AM Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com> wrote:]
> Hi Sara — great to hear from you. Short answers first: portal is preferred for onboarding (faster ACKs, automated PO matching), email to invoices@redwood.com is an acceptable fallback during the activation window.
> 
> Kimberly (AP) is copied — she manages the invoice template and PO stamping rules. Kimberly, can you drop the compact template and the onboarding form for Acme?', 'From: Sara Bennett <sara@acmesupply.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice intake question for activation

Thanks Kimberly — that all makes sense and the filename convention is clear. We will:
- Fill and return the onboarding form by end of day tomorrow.
- Submit one sample invoice via the portal once access is provisioned; if access is delayed we will email invoices@redwood.com using the filename convention you provided.

I attached our sample invoice (same one I referenced earlier) reformatted to match the compact CSV template you sent. Question: we sometimes include lines that span multiple POs (contracting work split across two POs) — should we submit one combined invoice with both PO numbers in the filename, or separate invoices per PO?

Appreciate the quick turnaround on access; we‘ll wait for the portal test ACK before routing larger invoices.

Best,
Sara Bennett
Vendor Onboarding Lead
Acme Supply

Attachment: acme_sample_invoice_07_22.pdf (reformatted sample)', '']
